decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed single storey rear/side infill extension, by virtue of its size, appearance and position, would cause undue harm to neighbour's living conditions, through a loss of light and outlook for the property at 30 Woodstock Road, and a loss of outlook onto the garden area for upper flats at 28 Woodstock Road. The proposal would therefore be contrary to UPD policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed single storey rear/side infill extension, by virtue of its size, appearance and position, would appear disproportionate in size and bulk to the existing listed property and would harm the balance of the listed terraced dwellings within the Bedford Park Conservation Area. The proposed extension would fail to preserve the Bedford Park Conservation Area and is contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings of Local Townscape Character) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), of the Unitary Development Plan (2003), and falls outside the guidance provided by Sections 1.0, 3.0 and 8.0 of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the ground floor flat.
